arStrings.szText: {c_important}Mighty Throw{/c} grants {c_number}[{SF_9} * 100|%+|]{/c} increased Attack Speed for {c_number}{SF_42}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Mighty Throw{/c} hurls another {c_number}[SF_22]{/c} weapons, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_DAMAGE_VARIANTA}{/c} damage upon impact, and pulses for {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE_VARIANTA}{/c} damage.
Swapping weapons near any of {c_important}Mighty Throw's{/c} thrown weapons creates an additional pulse for {c_number}{payload:EXTRA_PULSE}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Mighty Throw{/c} is now an {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill that drops a massive weapon for {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_DAMAGE_CVARIANT}{/c} damage with a {c_number}[{SF_46}]{/c} second cooldown. 

This cooldown cannot be reduced by Cooldown Reduction.

{c_important}Mighty Throw{/c} generates up to {c_number}[{SF_34} * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,{shield:BARRIER})]){/c} as a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_35} ||]{/c} seconds.
Grants {c_number}[{SF_49}]{/c} stacks of {u}{c_important}Ferocity{/u}{/c} each time you use {c_important}Mighty Throw{/c}.
{c_important}Mighty Throw{/c} now consumes one of your {u}{c_important}Overpower{/u}{/c} stacks to deal {c_number}[{SF_50} * 100|x%|]{/c} increased damage.
